portability.title: Account data portability
portability.description: Export your account data or import a supported ZIP archive.
portability.export.title: Export account
portability.export.description: Download your portable account data. Secrets and derived data are excluded.
portability.export.success: Your account export was downloaded successfully.
portability.import.title: Import account
portability.import.description: Import an account or supported chat ZIP as new local data. Sign-in data and settings stay unchanged.
portability.import.autoDetectNote: Choose a ZIP file. Its supported format is detected automatically.
portability.import.warning.accountIdenti: Sign-in data and settings stay unchanged.
portability.import.warning.newCopies: Data is added as copies; exact memories are skipped.
portability.import.warning.attachments: Original attachment files are not imported.
portability.import.warning.binaryAssets: Private files are restored together with their messages or documents.
portability.import.warning.binaryAssetCo: This archive's private files require a version 2 compatible importer.
portability.import.warning.privateAssets: Private files are not included in this legacy export. Create a version 2 export to include them.
portability.import.warning.chatBranch: Some messages are sorted by time.
portability.import.warning.skippedConten: Unsupported chats or messages are skipped.
portability.import.warning.documentIndex: Some documents await indexing; their content remains safe.
portability.import.success: Imported {projects} projects, {documents} documents, {chats} chats, {messages} messages, {memories} Account Memory records, and {files} private files. Skipped {skipped} exact memory duplicates.
portability.errors.export: Could not export your account data.
portability.errors.preview: Could not preview this account import file.
portability.errors.previewResponse: The account import preview response was invalid.
portability.errors.invalidPackage: This ZIP file is invalid, unsafe, or unsupported.
portability.errors.changedFile: The selected ZIP no longer matches the file you previewed. Preview it again.
portability.errors.projectArchive: This is a project export. Import it from the Projects page instead.
portability.errors.commit: Could not import this account file.
portability.errors.commitResponse: The account import response was invalid.
